title: Webhook identity resolution preferred source metadata over sender identity
summary: A provider webhook parser resolved external user identity using source metadata before the sender object, risking association with the wrong channel identity. The fix changed precedence so explicit/payload identity remains first, then sender identity, then source fallback.
applicability: Webhook adapters with overlapping sender/source identifiers
exceptions: Provider-specific contracts may define a different authoritative field and should override generic fallback order explicitly
